name: VC Audio Bot
description: Multi-user Telegram Voice Chat Audio Bot — in-bot login, high volume/bass/echo/boost, live mic boost, full button UI.

API_ID.description: Telegram API ID — get from https://my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Telegram API Hash — get from https://my.telegram.org

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram user ID (numeric). Get it from @userinfobot

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Log channel/group ID. Default -1004303404961. Add the bot as admin there.

STRING_SESSION.description: Optional owner Pyrogram string session. Generate with @Session_generator_1bot or just /login inside the bot.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection URI (recommended for persistent storage). Free tier: mongodb.com/atlas

DEFAULT_ECHO.description: Enable echo effect by default (true/false). Default: true

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: Your Heroku app name (e.g. my-vc-bot). Used for deep links.
